title: Telangana Government Approves Land for Adilabad Airport Project
summary: The Telangana government has approved the acquisition of 2,009 acres of land for the development of an airport in Adilabad. The project has been sanctioned with a budget of ₹2,278 crore. The decision has elicited mixed reactions across the region.
summary_points: Telangana government approved land acquisition for Adilabad Airport.
2,009 acres of land will be acquired for the project.
A budget of ₹2,278 crore has been sanctioned.
The approval has generated mixed reactions.
title_hi: तेलंगाना सरकार ने आदिलाबाद हवाई अड्डे की परियोजना के लिए भूमि को मंजूरी दी

परियोजना के लिए 2,009 एकड़ भूमि का अधिग्रहण किया जाएगा।
